name: Kidstock! Creative Theater SUMMERSTAGE
description_short: Kidstock!'s SUMMERSTAGE theater day program in Winchester, MA for Pre-K (age 4+) through Grade 6, 9 AM–4:30 PM. Full show weeks ($650) end with a Friday presentation; individual-day weeks ($150 per day) mix art, music, drama and dance with no final show. Extended day runs 8 AM–6 PM for an added fee.
refund_policy_summary: Transfers to another week are free when space allows (you pay any tuition difference). Withdrawals must be emailed by noon on the Friday before your week. Withdraw 30+ days before that Friday: 100% tuition back minus the registration fee and a $50 cancellation fee per child per week. Within 29 days: 50% back. After that Friday: no refunds or credits. The $35 family registration fee is nonrefundable.
special_needs_notes: The program is nut-free, and staff check what's in lunch bags. Inhalers, EpiPens and any other medication must be handed to the office.
